stances.quote: Congresswoman Kat Cammack (FL-03) today announced that ten of her amendments were adopted in the National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2027 (H.R. 8800), which passed the House by a vote of 216-214. The legislation authorizes a pay raise for every service member and now advances to the Senate.
stances.reasoning: Text shows active support for NDAA including service member pay raises, indicating position favoring military funding.

stances.quote: Cammack helped craft and shepherd the Rural Health Transformation Program through committee, securing more than $200 million for Florida and delivering critical resources to rural communities across FL-03... as part of the Working Families Tax Cuts law.
stances.reasoning: Explicit involvement in advancing the Working Families Tax Cuts law demonstrates support for lower taxes.

stances.quote: Congresswoman Kat Cammack (FL-03) today announced more than $42.2 million in Rural Health Transformation Program investments benefiting health care providers and communities across North Central Florida, following her work in Congress to help craft and advance the legislation that created the program.
stances.reasoning: Proudly claims credit for securing and delivering over $42 million in new federal rural health spending.
